name: drilled_shaft_no_longer_declares_profile
why: IT IS THE REAL RED OF THE SENTENCE, and it is all in «non_contiene». The same shaft, with a through axial hole: the INTERNAL cylindrical face that it creates breaks the formula that rebuilds the profile from a solid of revolution. The description must keep saying that it is a part of revolution -- that is true -- and must STOP declaring the profile, which is no longer that one.
_why_it_is_the_defect_that_gives_no_erro: a sentence that declares «Ø30 for 40, Ø20 for 30, Ø34 for 20» on a part that no longer has that profile fails nothing: it is a right description of another part, and the model builds on it. It is caught only by demanding that a word DISAPPEAR, and that is why the operator «non_contiene» exists.
_why_that_face: @face(area~=907.92) is the Ø34 end face, the only planar face of 907.92 mm2 of the part: the others are the Ø30 end face (706.86) and the two annular shoulders (392.70 and 593.76). It is chosen by measurement and not by direction because on a solid of revolution the direction of the two ends depends on how the axis was born.

expect.tolerance_why: 55857.53 minus pi*5^2*90: the calculation has pi inside
